heading_en: Reference to the Definition of Default
summary_ja: デフォルト事由に基づく記録と推計、及び異なる定義のデータを用いる場合の要件を定める。
summary_en: Requires default events to be recorded and used for estimation, and allows data based on other definitions only if two conditions are met.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall, on the basis of default events, record the occurrence of default events for each asset class subject to the internal ratings-based approach and estimate PD and (where relevant) LGD and EAD; provided, however, that it may use internal data and external data based on a definition different from the default events if the following requirements are satisfied: (i) it complies with the provisions of Article 191 or Article 192; (ii) it makes appropriate adjustments to the internal data and external data so that the results are approximately equivalent to those obtained using default events.
